title: French firms in Brazil eye gains from EU-Mercosur trade deal
summary: French businesses in Brazil are looking to benefit from the newly inked EU-Mercosur deal which Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and EU chief Ursula von der Leyen on Friday hailed as a victory for multilateralism at a time of global volatility.
